scientific_integrity: Claim proved analytically with sharp local nonidentifiability; finite symbolic and numerical checks supplement but do not certify the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic identifiability concerns exact expected Poisson counts, not four realized stochastic counts.
Requires four disjoint, known, positive-duration windows, a known clock origin, constant background, one smooth Omori component and positive parameters.
The inverse may be arbitrarily ill-conditioned near limiting models or clustered windows; no uniform error bound or estimator is established.
Historical priority relative to general Chebyshev-system and shifted-power identifiability results is not independently certified.
title: Four count windows identify background-adjusted Omori decay sharply
